diagnosis.overview: The worker consistently fails due to a retrieval gap: it cannot reliably extract exact, structured data from the source documents (PDFs, images, live web listings), leading to approximate or mock data, omissions of required sections, and calculation errors based on incorrect input values (e.g., CBA base wage $251.06 vs. $252.06, bank balance $419,460.93 vs. $6,610,926.80).
diagnosis.root_cause: The worker consistently fails due to a retrieval gap: it cannot reliably extract exact, structured data from the source documents (PDFs, images, live web listings), leading to approximate or mock data, omissions of required sections, and calculation errors based on incorrect input values (e.g., CBA base wage $251.06 vs. $252.06, bank balance $419,460.93 vs. $6,610,926.80).
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Wire in an OCR-capable document-parsing and web-scraping tool that accurately extracts text, tables, and numerical values from PDFs, images, and live listing pages, so the worker can retrieve the true source data. 2) Add a prompt rule strictly prohibiting the generation of sample/mock data and requiring that every numerical value and textual detail be pulled directly from the source; if extraction fails, the worker must abort with an explicit failure message rather than fabricating output. 3) Configure the harness to detect repeated retrieval failures early and terminate the task to avoid wasteful loops and complete omissions.
